claim: A proto-belief document approaching the mint gate carries a mint manifest: a section enumerating the candidate beliefs the document will plant, one typed row each (structural type, draft claim, deps, grounding artifact), with rows recording their belief id as they plant so a document can mint some rows and remain live. Type commitment happens late, on manifest rows inside the document, never early as typed nursery documents: typing documents by eventual DAG type fragments the matter, forces classification at minimum information, and grows a shadow graph. Action items in a proto-belief document are prescription rows in its manifest, minted to the desk when firm; no mutable document competes with the graph as todo tracker.
